test_overview: Evaluated a 7-step test plan (max 54 pts) against a Pilot's Logbook app (account system + lesson-flight behavior). Steps 1-4 PASSED in full: Pilot registration auto-authenticates and routes to the Pilot Flight Logbook (empty state shown); Instructor registration blocks when License Number is blank (HTML5 required validation with 'Please fill out this field.') and, with 'CFI-TEST1-123', creates the account and routes to the Instructor Dashboard (empty endorsements state); duplicate email across roles is blocked with 'Email already registered'; and role-based login routes Pilot->'/'' and Instructor->'/instructor' correctly. Step 5 FAILED with a FATAL verification failure: the Instructor Profile correctly displayed read-only Name/Email and an editable License ('CFI-TEST1-123' initially), and updating to 'CFI-TEST1-456' showed a success message — BUT upon navigating away and returning to Profile (in-session), the License reverted to 'CFI-TEST1-123' instead of persisting as 'CFI-TEST1-456'. A fresh-session login confirmed the value WAS saved server-side, proving this is a client-side state-staleness bug (remount repopulates the Profile's license field from stale pre-save AuthContext state). A human QA doing exactly 'navigate away and return to Profile' would observe the old value and report non-persistence. Because this verification is fatal, step 5 scored 0 and the plan was terminated; steps 6 and 7 were not performed and scored 0. Total = 6+8+6+6 = 26.

steps.description: test_pilot_registration_routes_to_logbook - PASSED. Registered Pilot 'Test1 Pilot' (pilot.test1@example.com); account creation succeeded, auto-authenticated, routed to '/' Pilot Flight Logbook (not Instructor dashboard); logbook showed the empty state.

test_instructor_registration_requires_license_and_routes_to_dashboard - PASSED. Blank-license instructor submit was blocked (stayed on /register, unauthenticated) via HTML5 required validation ('Please fill out this field.') - acceptable as a required-field validation error. Completing with license 'CFI-TEST1-123' created the account, auto-authenticated as '🎓 Test1 Instructor', routed to '/instructor' Instructor Dashboard with empty endorsements state.

test_email_uniqueness_across_roles - PASSED. Attempting to register an Instructor using the Pilot's email was blocked with error 'Email already registered'; user remained on /register unauthenticated. Email uniqueness enforced across roles.
test_login_routes_by_role - PASSED. Pilot login landed on '/' Pilot Flight Logbook; Instructor login landed on '/instructor' Instructor Dashboard. Role-based routing correct.

test_instructor_license_editable_and_persists - FAILED (FATAL). Profile displayed read-only Name/Email and editable License 'CFI-TEST1-123' (initial OK); update to 'CFI-TEST1-456' showed 'License number updated.' (update appeared to succeed). BUT the required persistence verification 'navigate away and return to Profile; license still shows CFI-TEST1-456' FAILED - in-session it reverted to 'CFI-TEST1-123'. A fresh-session login showed 'CFI-TEST1-456' (server DID persist), proving a client-side state-staleness bug: the Profile's license field repopulates from stale pre-save AuthContext account state on remount. A human QA performing the plan's exact verification would observe the old value and report the update did not persist. Fatal -> step scores 0 and evaluation stops.
test_pilot_creates_lesson_flight_with_unsigned_status - NOT PERFORMED (0 pts). Evaluation stopped due to the fatal failure in step 5 per the stop-on-fatal rule.
test_logbook_lesson_filters - NOT PERFORMED (0 pts). Evaluation stopped due to the fatal failure in step 5 per the stop-on-fatal rule.
